form.eic-worksheet-a.line-3: Each sale on your Form 8949 should be one of two kinds. (1) A sale your broker reported to the IRS with its basis, with no adjustment other than a wash-sale loss or a correction of that basis. (2) A sale of stocks or other securities, entered only once and in the one box its statement gives it, with a basis you supply (the correct basis, even if your Form 1099-B showed a different one), net proceeds you supply when you got no Form 1099-B, and no adjustment other than a wash-sale loss. Is every sale on your Form 8949 one of these two kinds?

form.eic-worksheet-a.line-3: Each sale on your Form 8949 should be one of two kinds. (1) A sale your broker reported to the IRS with its basis, with no adjustment other than a wash-sale loss or a correction of that basis. (2) A sale of stocks or other securities, entered only once and in the one box its statement gives it, with a basis you supply (the correct basis, even if your Form 1099-B showed a different one), net proceeds you supply when you got no Form 1099-B, and no adjustment other than a wash-sale loss. Is every sale on your Form 8949 one of these two kinds?

(2) A sale of stocks or other securities, entered only once and in the one box its statement gives it, with a basis you supply (the correct basis, even if your Form 1099-B showed a different one), net proceeds you supply when you got no Form 1099-B, and no adjustment other than a wash-sale loss. Is every sale on your Form 8949 one of these two kinds?

form.eic-worksheet-a.line-3: Each sale on your Form 8949 should be one of two kinds. (1) A sale your broker reported to the IRS with its basis, with no adjustment other than a wash-sale loss or a correction of that basis. (2) A sale of stocks or other securities, entered only once and in the one box its statement gives it, with a basis you supply (the correct basis, even if your Form 1099-B showed a different one), net proceeds you supply when you got no Form 1099-B, and no adjustment other than a wash-sale loss. Is every sale on your Form 8949 one of these two kinds?

(2) A sale of stocks or other securities, entered only once and in the one box its statement gives it, with a basis you supply (the correct basis, even if your Form 1099-B showed a different one), net proceeds you supply when you got no Form 1099-B, and no adjustment other than a wash-sale loss. Is every sale on your Form 8949 one of these two kinds?
